claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ro-04-5595 is a weak, low-potency GluN2B-selective NMDA receptor antagonist (EC50 ~186 nM) with no described cytotoxic mechanism, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.
